target.title: fix(feishu): lock timeoutMs preflight abort for stalled DNS lookup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Feishu app registration goes through `fetchWithSsrFGuard`. Operators need a locked regression that a **stalled DNS/proxy preflight** is cancelled by the guard's existing top-level `timeoutMs` before any HTTP request is dispatched.

## Why This Change Was Made

ClawSweeper P1 on the prior tip identified that the `signal: AbortSignal.timeout()` path in `fetchFeishuJson` drops guard-owned timeout diagnostics. This iteration restores `timeoutMs` (the guard's top-level param), keeping the shared `request timed out` diagnostic and `buildTimeoutAbortSignal` preflight abort.

**This iteration:**
- Rebased on latest `main`
- **Kept** guard `timeoutMs` (no production ownership change)
- Added stalled-lookup regression next to the existing hang-POST timeout proof, matching its outcome shape
- No production code changed — test-only addition (+27 lines)

## User Impact

- **Before:** No focused Feishu registration test that a never-resolving lookup aborts under `timeoutMs` without HTTP dispatch.
- **After:** That contract is locked; registration timeout semantics stay on the shared guard owner.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `d60a33276f8`
**Base:** `92e5a10f1a9`

### Regression test suite (11/11 pass)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts --reporter verbose extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.10

 ✓ Feishu app registration > defaults unsafe begin polling lifetimes 241ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > clamps unsafe poll sleeps 19ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > prints scan-to-create QR codes 2ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > times out registration POSTs (TCP hang) 95ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > rejects with timeout when preflight lookup stalls 83ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > rejects Feishu API responses that exceed 16 MiB cap 232ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > parses under-cap JSON 50ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > sends bound reads through real SSRF guard 11ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > wraps malformed JSON with feishu.api error 8ms
 ✓ feishu bound reads > rejects oversized response (OOM guard) 114ms
 ✓ feishu bound reads > parses well-formed JSON under cap 31ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
 Start at  16:36:03
 Duration  7.17s
```

### Matched outcome shape

| Assertion | Existing POST hang test | New stalled-DNS test |
|---|---|---|
| abort mechanism | `timeoutMs` → guard `buildTimeoutAbortSignal` | `timeoutMs` → guard `buildTimeoutAbortSignal` |
| outcome | `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` | `TimeoutError` |
| `fetch_called` | reaches TCP listener | false |
| elapsed | 88ms | 82ms |

### Stalled-lookup proof output

```
✓ |extension-feishu| Feishu app registration > rejects with timeout when preflight lookup stalls (DNS/proxy stall protection) 83ms
  [feishu preflight stall proof] timed_out name=TimeoutError elapsed_ms=82 fetch_called=0
```

- `elapsed_ms=82` — guard timeout fired within the 80ms window
- `fetch_called=0` — no HTTP request was dispatched (aborted during DNS preflight)

### Test code

Located at `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts:379-404` — placed as sibling of the existing "times out registration POSTs when accounts never return headers" test, using identical outcome shape (`timeoutMs: 80`, `then/catch` split, same elapsed window).

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
